lastCompletedStory.title: Fix three misleading comments/names without changing any behavior

nextStoryContext: Three comment/name-only fixes landed, no behavior changed (verified via byte-unchanged function-body diffs against main for hasUnguardedSedLineAnchor, findCommandSubstitutionEnd, and extractCommandSubstitutionSpans, plus an unchanged LIVE_DERIVATION_RE line and unchanged '^export ' surface). CAM-384: test/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.test.ts's 'frozen-comparand rule: flagged forms' describe block had a test named 'does not match main by literal substring -- mainbranch is not the main token' even though the assertion is `.not.toBeNull()` (i.e. it DOES flag); renamed to 'flags a mainbranch: ref, which is not the main token', command string byte-unchanged. CAM-385: hasUnguardedSedLineAnchor's doc comment (src/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.ts) claimed the guard must 'precede' the anchor; the implementation's guardRe.test(command) has no positional constraint (it scans the whole command), so the comment now says the guard must be 'present anywhere in the command'. CAM-392: the extractCommandSubstitutionSpans JSDoc block was sitting above findCommandSubstitutionEnd (comment-code mismatch); swapped the two adjacent JSDoc blocks so each function now has its own doc directly above it -- findCommandSubstitutionEnd's doc first, then the function, then extractCommandSubstitutionSpans's doc directly above extractCommandSubstitutionSpans. No fs/network paths touched. Full bun run check:all spine ran green in one pass (test 5243 pass/0 fail, embed-vendor, lint, file-size, debt-markers, version-skips, coverage, dead-code, dup, ci-parity, agents-md, test-sleeps all ok) -- no ceiling/floor raises needed. Pure doc/name-only story; no new reusable pattern worth a patterns.md bullet.
